newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall sharply at last auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall sharply at last auction.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices fell sharply due to poor quality of teas at the last auction of the season, brokers said.
Brokers said the market was depressed as overseas buyers including Poland and Jordan operated at a lower level. However, the prices of clean leaf teas rose on demand from internal buyers, they said.
Some 319,200 kgs of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 46.64 taka per kg, 6.27 taka down from previous sale.
The first auction of the new season is expected to begin in May.
